# Haulin Junkies

> Haulin Junkies is a locally owned, licensed and insured roll-off dumpster rental and junk removal company based in Maitland, FL, serving Orlando and 27+ Central Florida cities. Dumpsters come in 12, 15, 20 and 25 yard sizes plus a 45 yard combo (20 + 25 yard) for $700; the 12 yard is $400 for a 3-day rental with 4,000 lbs included. Same-day and next-day delivery available. Call (407) 815-4926.

Haulin Junkies rents roll-off dumpsters to homeowners, contractors, roofers, and property managers, and also handles residential and commercial junk removal and specialty hauling (estate cleanouts, foreclosure cleanouts, appliances, carpet, concrete, hot tubs, and construction debris) across the greater Orlando metro area. Pricing is based on truck space used, not by the hour or item count — free upfront estimates are provided before any work begins. The company sorts every load and donates usable items to Central Florida charity partners before anything goes to a landfill.

## Dumpster Rental (Orlando & Central Florida)

- [Dumpster Rental Orlando FL](https://haulinjunkies.com/dumpster-rentals.php): Roll-off dumpster rental with flat-rate pricing and no hidden fees.
- 12 yard dumpster: $400 for 3 days with up to 4,000 lbs. Garage or attic cleanouts, one-room remodels, yard debris.
- 15 yard dumpster: price quoted by phone. Kitchen or bath remodels, medium home cleanouts.
- 20 yard dumpster: price quoted by phone. Roof tear-offs, large renovations, whole-home and estate cleanouts.
- 25 yard dumpster: price quoted by phone. Commercial construction, demolition, multi-unit cleanouts.
- 45 yard combo (a 20 yard and a 25 yard delivered together): $700. The biggest cleanouts and construction jobs.
- Every rental includes delivery and pickup, driveway protection boards, rear double-door walk-in loading, and cleanup after pickup. Longer rentals available on request.
- Same-day and next-day delivery across the Orlando metro, including Winter Park, Maitland, Altamonte Springs, Lake Mary, Sanford, Oviedo, Apopka, Ocoee, Winter Garden, Windermere, Kissimmee, St. Cloud, and Clermont.
- Not allowed in dumpsters: hazardous materials, paint, tires, and batteries.
- Permits: none needed on a private driveway; street or sidewalk placement may need a city right-of-way permit.
- [Junk Removal vs. Dumpster Rental](https://haulinjunkies.com/junk-removal-vs-dumpster-rental.php): When a dumpster is cheaper than a junk removal crew, and vice versa.

## Core Services

- [Residential Junk Removal](https://haulinjunkies.com/residential.php): Home cleanouts, furniture, appliances, and general junk removal.
- [Commercial Junk Removal & Hauling](https://haulinjunkies.com/commercial.php): Offices, warehouses, retail, and construction sites across Central Florida.
- [Estate Cleanout Services](https://haulinjunkies.com/estate-cleanout.php): Compassionate, full-service property cleanouts for families, downsizing, and estate sales.
- [Foreclosure Cleanouts](https://haulinjunkies.com/foreclosure-cleanout.php): Fast, insured property cleanouts for banks, realtors, and investors.
- [Appliance Removal](https://haulinjunkies.com/appliance-removal.php): Refrigerators, washers, dryers, and other appliance haul-off.
- [Carpet Removal](https://haulinjunkies.com/carpet-removal.php): Old carpet and flooring removal.
- [Concrete Removal](https://haulinjunkies.com/concrete-removal.php): Concrete, masonry, and construction debris removal.
- [Hot Tub Removal](https://haulinjunkies.com/hot-tub-removal.php): Hot tub and spa removal and disposal.
- [Cardboard Removal](https://haulinjunkies.com/cardboard-removal.php): Bulk cardboard and packaging removal.
- [Material Logistics](https://haulinjunkies.com/material-logistics.php): Material hauling and logistics services.
- [Moving Help, Vehicle Moving & Delivery Runs](https://haulinjunkies.com/moving-services.php): Same-day and last-minute moving help, local vehicle and car moving, and point-to-point delivery runs across Orlando and Central Florida.
- [Senior Move Management & Downsizing Help](https://haulinjunkies.com/senior-move-management.php): Compassionate senior move management — downsizing and sort-planning help, packing and unpacking, moving day coordination, estate cleanout and donation coordination, and full home setup ("Homecoming Setup") at the new address. Serves seniors, adult children coordinating a parent's move, and families managing estate transitions.
- [Apartment Cleanouts](https://haulinjunkies.com/apartment-cleanouts.php): Full-service apartment and unit turnover cleanouts.
